rows.ARS:
Red blend Shrub.
Registration name: ORApaymel
rows.Origin:
Bred by Pierre Orard (France, before 1999).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2001 as 'Heart 'n' Soul'.
rows.Bloom: White, red edges. None to mild, tea fragrance. 18 to 22 petals. Average diameter 3". Medium, semi-double to double, borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, high-centered to cupped, ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Spreading, upright. Medium, glossy, dark green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 4' to 5' (120 to 150cm). Width: 43" to 4'1" (110 to 125cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Protect tender new spring growth from hard freezes that may cause canker, die-back and death of the plant. . Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood..
